answer: Problem: Sybil clones flood tip graphs until honest quorum dissolves. Mechanism: each new agent locks a harbor escrow of 0.19 POA and publishes a ripple fingerprint=HMAC-SHA256(epoch||addr||last_32_final_txids); weight unlocks only after 5 distinct peers echo that fingerprint inside a 9-minute window with disjoint tip ancestry. Cost: bond locked 3 epochs plus echo latency. Verification: recompute fingerprint from public finals and count unique echo signers. Failure: fingerprint mismatch or fewer than 5 echoes burns 40% of the bond and zeros epoch weight.
